name: Burun Fortress
title: Burun Fortress
summary: A huge Burun fortress in the Blackmire swamp, about 71 x 86 m: corner buildings of 31 m, two central keeps of 48 m, tapered east towers of 41 m, and a gatehouse on the south side fronted by a field of fallen Burun and the Blueprints table.

landmarks.name: Field of fallen Burun and Blueprints table
landmarks.note: Bodies 0x02001132-34 and the Blueprints for a Burun Fortress at (35556, 18278.7).

site.name: Burun Fortress

shots.standingOrder: Orbit Burun Fortress clockwise at 115 m radius and 52 m height from south-west toward west; stay 14 m from the giant swamp tree crowns.
shots.notes: Hero orbit of the whole fortress - corner towers, the two central keeps and the tapered east towers - above the swamp; south-west sun (0.63) lights the faces the camera sees. Verified (check.mjs, full take flown): take 0-10 s: AGL 46.57..51 m, nearest drawn 14.61 m (scenery-default 0x020003EE@35483,18273), vmax 6.5 m/s, LOS blocked 0/41, subject in frame 100%; edit 2-8.5 s: AGL 46.57..49.3 m, nearest drawn 14.61 m (scenery-default 0x020003EE@35483,18273), vmax 6.5 m/s, LOS blocked 0/27, subject in frame 100%; flight cinema peak 6.52 m/s (cap 12), max tracking gap 0.03 m.

shots.standingOrder: Rise from 3 m to 33 m above the battlefield 96 m south of Burun Fortress, drifting 6 m north, until the keeps clear the south wall; stay 3.5 m from the bushes and 40 m from the walls.
shots.notes: Opener for the Blackmire fortress: rises from the battlefield in front of the gate until the two 48 m central keeps clear the 28-31 m south wall; LOS to the keep is blocked by the wall for the first ~2 s of the window by design (the reveal). Verified (check.mjs, full take flown): take 0-11 s: AGL 3..33.5 m, nearest drawn 3.62 m (scenery-default 0x02001063@35557,18243), vmax 4.44 m/s, LOS blocked 21/45, subject in frame 100%; edit 3-9.5 s: AGL 8.26..32.1 m, nearest drawn 7.38 m (scenery-default 0x02001063@35557,18243), vmax 4.44 m/s, LOS blocked 9/27, subject in frame 100%; flight cinema peak 4.43 m/s (cap 12), max tracking gap 0.04 m. [critic b4-7 2026-10-15: window.anchor center -> end. LOS to the keeps is blocked by the south wall until t 5.5; the centred 6.2 s window [3.17, 9.37] spent 2.3 s (8/25 LOS samples, 32%) on the wall and cut the settle at the top. Anchored at the keep end (10.5) the window is about [4.3, 10.5]: about 1.2 s of lead-in, then the keeps clear the wall and the climb eases to its hold.]

shots.standingOrder: Hold 0.7 m above the ground 38 m south of the fortress gatehouse beyond the fallen Burun and look up at its 22 m wall, pushing 2 m in; keep 3 m from the trees.
shots.notes: Low angle on the gatehouse beyond the field of fallen Burun and the Blueprints table; afternoon sun from the south-west. shots.standingOrder: Race north 5 m off the west wall of Burun Fortress at 15 m height and 11.5 m/s with the wall on the right; stay 7 m above the tree tops and never drift toward the wall.
shots.notes: Fast FPV skim along the sunlit west wall (sun south-west) at 15 m, the corner towers and wall faces streaking past on the right; subject metrics not applicable (path move).
